tools.name: chitchats_list_shipments
tools.description: List shipments, newest first. Filter by status (pending, ready, in_transit, received, released, inducted, resolved, delivered, exception, voided). Good first call to find shipment ids. Chit Chats API: GET /api/v1/clients/{client_id}/shipments.

tools.name: chitchats_get_shipment
tools.description: Get one shipment: addresses, status, carrier and tracking code, purchase amount, label URLs, line items and rates. Chit Chats API: GET /api/v1/clients/{client_id}/shipments/{id}.

tools.name: chitchats_count_shipments
tools.description: Count all shipments on the account. Chit Chats API: GET /api/v1/clients/{client_id}/shipments/count.

tools.name: chitchats_list_batches
tools.description: List batches (groups of shipments handed to Chit Chats), newest first. Filter by status: pending, ready (all shipments ready to receive) or received. Chit Chats API: GET /api/v1/clients/{client_id}/batches.

tools.name: chitchats_get_batch
tools.description: Get one batch with its status and description. Chit Chats API: GET /api/v1/clients/{client_id}/batches/{id}.

tools.name: chitchats_count_batches
tools.description: Count all batches on the account. Chit Chats API: GET /api/v1/clients/{client_id}/batches/count.

tools.name: chitchats_list_returns
tools.description: List returned shipments, newest first, with status (on_hold, in_transit, ready, resolved) and return reason. Chit Chats API: GET /api/v1/clients/{client_id}/returns.

tools.name: chitchats_create_shipment
tools.description: Create a shipment record. The new shipment has status unpaid: this call does NOT buy postage, and no credits are spent. Buy postage in the Chit Chats dashboard. Use postage_type 'unknown' to see rates first. Chit Chats API: POST /api/v1/clients/{client_id}/shipments.

tools.name: chitchats_refresh_shipment_rates
tools.description: Change the options of a shipment and recalculate its rates (insurance, signature, hazmat, ship date). This does NOT buy postage. Chit Chats API: PATCH /api/v1/clients/{client_id}/shipments/{id}/refresh.

tools.name: chitchats_add_shipments_to_batch
tools.description: Put shipments into a batch. Calling it again with the same shipments changes nothing. Chit Chats API: PATCH /api/v1/clients/{client_id}/shipments/add_to_batch.

tools.name: chitchats_remove_shipments_from_batch
tools.description: Take shipments out of the batch they belong to. Calling it again with the same shipments changes nothing. Chit Chats API: PATCH /api/v1/clients/{client_id}/shipments/remove_from_batch.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: chitchats_list_shipments, chitchats_get_shipment, chitchats_count_shipments, chitchats_list_batches, chitchats_get_batch, chitchats_count_batches, chitchats_list_returns · Private data: chitchats_create_shipment · Public sink: chitchats_create_shipment · Destructive: chitchats_remove_shipments_from_batch.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: chitchats_list_shipments, chitchats_get_shipment, chitchats_count_shipments, chitchats_list_batches, chitchats_get_batch, chitchats_count_batches, chitchats_list_returns · Private data: chitchats_create_shipment · Public sink: chitchats_create_shipment · Destructive: chitchats_remove_shipments_from_batch

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
